lenis.min.js — Lenis 1.3.26, the smooth-scrolling library.
MIT licence, (c) 2024 darkroom.engineering — https://github.com/darkroom-engineering/lenis

It is the same file the Edgware Youth site uses, copied here as-is so the
two sites scroll the same way. It is only downloaded on a computer with a
mouse, and never when someone has asked their device to reduce motion.

To upgrade it: download the new lenis.min.js from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@<version>/dist/lenis.min.js,
replace this file with it, and update the version above.
